description:
How big will the New Jerusalem be? What wonders await within its walls? Join us as we dive into the Bible to uncover the answers to these questions and many more! This program is driven by our viewers’ submitted questions and will be explored and answered straight from God’s Word.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. If I go to church on Sunday, will I still go to Heaven as long as I'm reading my Bible and believing in Jesus? Will I go to Heaven if I attend church on Sunday?

2. The Bible tells us that Judas betrayed Jesus and sold him to the chief priests. He had remorse for doing this but didn’t repent. Was there a possibility for him to repent and be forgiven after Jesus was given over to the judges? What was the cut-off point in terms of time for Judas to repent after Jesus was passed into the hands of his enemies? Could Judas have repented?

3. Why do those I pray for seem to prosper while my own life seems to fall apart?  

4. Can you show where the abomination of desolation is the Sunday law? 

5. If some angels were cast out with Satan and some stayed in Heaven, were there some angels cast to earth being undecided who they wished to follow?  Where some angels cast to earth?

6. Can a divorcee re-marry if the spouse committed adultery? Romans 7:1-3 and 1 Corinthians 7:10-13 say if you re-marry you commit adultery. Please help me understand.  

7. In Revelation 4, John, while in the spirit, was given a glimpse of the throne room of God. Who are the four creatures that John saw? Who are the four creatures that John saw in Revelation? 

8. If Adam and Eve had eaten from the Tree of Life could evil have been eradicated? What about Lucifer, did he have the opportunity to eat from it? 

9. What is the meaning of John 14:14? I understand that we are to ask for things consistent with God's will and that sometimes God's answer to prayers is no, but this text says the answer is yes. 

10. I've heard it said that the New Jerusalem is about the size of the state of Oregon. If that's the case, not very many people are going to be saved. Does this include those who will inherit the Earth? How big will the New Jerusalem be?

11. I know the Bible says to get out of the cities. It seems that cities have been built up everywhere. What do I do as a senior citizen with disabilities? Are we to flee the cities?

12. Can you please explain 1 Timothy 2:14-15?
